# Triage: review-01-messy-ts-app

## Block merge (8)

These are real bugs or environment-breakers that will silently fail in CI/prod, not stylistic concerns.

| ID | Charge | Severity / agent_risk | Why block |
|----|--------|----------------------|-----------|
| crime_00008 | Localhost-on-Disk (`/Users/andrew/dev/crimes/schema.json`) | med / 0.53 | Hardcoded user-home path. Works on exactly one machine; breaks for every other dev and all CI. Must be removed before merge regardless of severity rating. |
| crime_00007 | Dev-Server URL (`localhost:3000`) | med / 0.53 | Hardcoded localhost in `src/api/files.ts`. Silently fails in every non-local environment. |
| crime_00003 | Half-UTC, Half-Local | high / 0.61 | Same Date receiver mixes UTC + local methods — silently wrong by the host's UTC offset. Off-by-timezone bugs are notoriously hard to debug post-merge. |
| crime_00009 | Timezone Roulette | med / 0.53 | `new Date("2026-12-25T07:00:00")` without zone marker. Parses differently per host TZ — must be pinned before shipping date logic. |
| crime_00002 | Temporal Recklessness (`src/date.ts`, 8×) | high / 0.62 | This is *the* date module. If domain code can't be tested deterministically here, the whole date surface becomes load-bearing wall-clock code. |
| crime_00021 | False Identity — `calculateRefundPreview` does I/O | med / 0.44 | A "preview" function that calls `saveRefundAudit` + `sendRefundEmail` will get invoked from preview UI by the next agent. Rename or extract before merge. |
| crime_00020 | Test "renders the enterprise plan" has 0 expects | med / 0.46 | A green test that asserts nothing is worse than no test — it creates false confidence. Either assert behaviour or delete. |
| crime_00017 | Route Metadata Drift `/settings/billing` | med / 0.49 | Path/file/component/title/nav all disagree (Plans vs Subscription vs Billing). User-visible inconsistency; an agent will pick wrong one when extending. |

## Warn (16)

Genuine issues but not merge-blockers — should be tracked and fixed soon.

| ID | Charge | Sev / a_risk | Note |
|----|--------|--------------|------|
| crime_00001 | SVG with embedded raster | high / 0.70 | High sev is build/perf hygiene, not correctness. |
| crime_00005 | God Function `generateInvoice` (204 LOC) | high / 0.55 | Works today; refactor improves agent-safety. |
| crime_00019 | Temporal Recklessness in `billing.ts` (7×) | med / 0.46 | Same family as crime_00002; track together. |
| crime_00004 | Concept Alias Drift (tenant/account/org/team/workspace) | med / 0.58 | Five terms for one concept across docs + routes. Will breed duplicate logic. |
| crime_00010 | "enterprise" literal in 4 files | med / 0.52 | Pre-duplication signal; lift to constant before adding a fifth. |
| crime_00011 | DST-Naive `+ 86400000` | med / 0.52 | Real bug, but only fires on DST transition days. |
| crime_00015 | Duplicated Nav Source (`Plans` vs `Billing`) | med / 0.49 | Pairs with crime_00017; one fix should resolve both. |
| crime_00027 | Logic-in-Comment: "Only owners can refund enterprise…" | med / 0.42 | Prose rule that nearby code doesn't encode — bug factory. |
| crime_00016 | 14 TODOs in `src/todo.ts` (424/kLOC) | med / 0.49 | Hard to tell load-bearing from aspirational. |
| crime_00006 | Missing AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md | med / 0.53 | Codebase is going to be edited by agents; meta-risk on every future change. |
| crime_00022 | Sync I/O in hot path | low / 0.44 | Worth knowing about server-side. |
| crime_00026 | God File `billing.ts` (310 LOC) | med / 0.42 | Just over threshold; ride along with crime_00005 refactor. |
| crime_00033 | Plural Mismatch (`users: User`, `invoice: Invoice[]`) | low / 0.40 | Naming/type disagreement — likely indicates a real per-call bug. |
| crime_00013 | Docs-Code Drift (`docs/teams.md` → `./setup.md` missing) | low / 0.51 | Stale link an agent might follow. |
| crime_00034–36 | 3× Orphaned Destination (account/subscription, team, workspace/members) | low / 0.39 each | Routes unreachable from any nav/import — either in flight or dead code, but all three carry the same alias drift as crime_00004, so worth flagging now. |
| crime_00024 / crime_00025 | Date String Sewing + Host-Locale Drift | low / 0.43 | Pair with the date refactor for crime_00002. |

## Ignore (13)

Stylistic / low-impact in this PR's context. Not worth gating merge on; some are auto-fixable.

- **crime_00012** Oversized Raster 254 KB — under the 500 KB medium threshold; perf tuning not a merge gate.
- **crime_00014** Icon-Sized Raster (32×32 PNG) — design polish.
- **crime_00023** 1× `Date.now()` in `src/api/state.ts` — single instance; absorbed by the bigger date-injection effort if/when it happens.
- **crime_00028 / crime_00029** Unprefixed booleans (`paid`, `expired`, `stale`, `disableBilling`, `skipRetry`) — rename later; doesn't change behaviour.
- **crime_00030** Option bag junk drawer (`describeCheckout`) — generic style.
- **crime_00031** Return Shape Roulette — only confidence 0.73; would warn if `petty.ts` were on a hot path.
- **crime_00032** Negative Flag Maze (`!disableBilling && !skipRetry`) — readability.
- **crime_00037** Weak assertion matcher — distinct from crime_00020 (this one *has* an expect, just weak). Track but not a blocker.
- **crime_00038** 4 TODOs / 12.9 per kLOC — barely over threshold; nothing like crime_00016.

## Triage logic

- **agent_risk alone doesn't sort this** — crime_00001 (0.70) is a warn while crime_00008 (0.53) is a block, because hardcoded `/Users/andrew/` is environment-fatal regardless of how the scoring model weights it. Severity + concrete consequence > scaled score.
- **Block tier = "merging this ships a bug or breaks an environment"**: hardcoded paths/URLs, timezone-ambiguous parses, side-effect mismatched names, tests that assert nothing, user-visible label drift.
- **Warn tier = "real issue, but doesn't make the PR worse than `main`"**: large functions/files, scattered literals, missing agent docs, todo density, sync I/O. These accumulate; gate them via separate cleanup PRs.
- **Ignore tier = "true positives but cosmetic at this scale"**: naming prefixes, single-instance offenders, low-overhead asset issues, return-shape lint.

**Headline numbers**: 8 block / 16 warn / 13 ignore — driven mainly by the date layer (`src/date.ts` + dated reads in `billing.ts`) and the `/settings/billing` naming chaos. Fixing those two clusters retires roughly half the report.
